name: opscale
description: Discover and run your organization's OPSCALE Skills. Bundles the OPSCALE MCP server and a procedure skill that checks OPSCALE once per request.

interface.longDescription: OPSCALE is a multi-tenant platform where organizations author, publish, and govern agent Skills. This plugin connects Codex to the OPSCALE MCP server and adds a procedure skill that checks OPSCALE once per request, runs a matching Skill, and reads its bundle files correctly. Access is controlled by OPSCALE OAuth; the plugin contains no organization content.
